## [purpose] Purpose

Build a before-work checklist for station work and field visits covering supplies, route, reporting contact and explicit pause conditions.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

60 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 4 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare local incident contacts, route reporting and buddy-system rules. Use a fictional route.

## [opening] Opening

There is a threat on the route but many visits remain. What is safe?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The second response secures a safe approach and coordination. Visit targets do not justify entering danger; the route and return time still need to be known.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target. A checklist must support a decision about safe starting conditions, not just list equipment.

## [practice] Practice activity

Fill a card: task and scope; supplies and protection; route and weather; contact and return time; pause conditions. Tell your partner: “There is no soap and a threat on the route.” Explain what pauses and whose decision is needed. Alone, write the response. Before the next visit, confirm the route and contact.

## [answer-key] Answer key

2. Avoid the threat and arrange an alternative with the supervisor.

The second response secures a safe approach and coordination. Visit targets do not justify entering danger; the route and return time still need to be known.

## [observe] Observe

Completes the five checklist fields, identifies the unsafe task to pause and supervisor to contact, and includes heat, route and return-time planning.

Ready: Completes the five checklist fields, identifies the unsafe task to pause and supervisor to contact, and includes heat, route and return-time planning. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Lists supplies and route but misses a contact or pause condition; complete these before repeating the briefing.

Not yet: Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Lists supplies and route but misses a contact or pause condition; complete these before repeating the briefing. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23. The five hazard groups span both source-table pages. A local clinical trainer must review demonstrations and referral pathways. Immediate needlestick evaluation was checked against CDC on 25 September 2026. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

## [purpose] Layunin

Bumuo ng before-work checklist para sa station at field visit na may supplies, ruta, reporting contact at malinaw na dahilan kung kailan magpa-pause.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

60 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 4 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang lokal na incident contact, route reporting at buddy-system rules. Gumamit ng kunwaring ruta.

## [opening] Pambungad

May banta sa ruta ngunit mahaba pa ang visit list. Ano ang ligtas na hakbang?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang ikalawang sagot ay inuuna ang ligtas na paraan at koordinasyon. Ang visit target ay hindi dahilan upang pumasok sa banta; kailangan pa ring alam ang ruta at oras ng balik.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target. Ang checklist ay dapat may desisyon kung ligtas nang magsimula, hindi listahan lamang ng gamit.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Punan ang card: gawain at saklaw; supplies at proteksyon; ruta at panahon; contact at oras ng balik; dahilan para mag-pause. Sabihin sa kapareha: “Walang sabon at may banta sa ruta.” Ipakita kung ano ang hindi muna gagawin at kanino hihingi ng pasya. Kung mag-isa, sagutin ang parehong sitwasyon sa papel. Bago ang susunod na visit, kumpirmahin ang ruta at contact.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

2. Iwasan ang banta at ayusin ang alternatibo kasama ang supervisor.

Ang ikalawang sagot ay inuuna ang ligtas na paraan at koordinasyon. Ang visit target ay hindi dahilan upang pumasok sa banta; kailangan pa ring alam ang ruta at oras ng balik.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Kumpleto ang limang bahagi ng checklist; natutukoy ang unsafe task na ihihinto at supervisor na kokontakin; kasama ang heat, route at return-time plan.

Kaya na: Kumpleto ang limang bahagi ng checklist; natutukoy ang unsafe task na ihihinto at supervisor na kokontakin; kasama ang heat, route at return-time plan. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: May supplies at ruta ngunit kulang ang contact o pause condition; ipapunan bago muling magbrief.

Hindi pa: Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

May supplies at ruta ngunit kulang ang contact o pause condition; ipapunan bago muling magbrief. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 30; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 21, 22, 23. Ang limang hazard group ay mula sa dalawang pahina ng source table. Suriin ng lokal na clinical trainer ang demo at referral pathway. Ang agarang needlestick evaluation ay sinuri sa CDC noong 25 Setyembre 2026. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.

## [station-preparation] Prepare the area and equipment

Ana, 33, is preparing for station work and home visits on a hot day. She needs to check supplies and the route with the midwife.

Arrange for the slippery entrance to be corrected and keep people away from the hazard. Check for the correct sharps container, hand-hygiene supplies and PPE required for the task. Know the safe route and incident contact. If essential protection is missing or a task exceeds training, pause and escalate to the supervisor. Gloves or a mask do not replace removing a hazard when removal is possible.

## [field-preparation] Plan a safe field visit

Before leaving, check weather, slippery paths, dogs and possible threats. Share the route and expected return time; use a buddy system when local protocols call for one. Carry drinking water and plan shade and rest during heat. Do not enter an unsafe situation; arrange an alternative. Report accidents, bites or illness promptly and follow the appropriate referral rather than finishing the household list first.

## [combined-hazards] When hazards combine

Clients arrive in a surge, the room is hot and some PPE is unavailable. As a group, identify tasks to pause, tasks that can be modified and who must decide. Consider staffing capacity and client flow; extra BHW hours should not be the only answer. Propose one safer alternative for supervisor approval.

## [practice] Try it, then repeat

Fill a card: task and scope; supplies and protection; route and weather; contact and return time; pause conditions. Tell your partner: “There is no soap and a threat on the route.” Explain what pauses and whose decision is needed. Alone, write the response. Before the next visit, confirm the route and contact.

## [check] Choose the next step

Choose an answer and explain why before viewing the feedback. Then compare it with your own practice attempt.

## [station-preparation] Ihanda ang lugar at kagamitan

Si Ana, 33, ay naghahanda ng station duty at home visits sa mainit na araw. May mga gamit at rutang kailangan munang suriin kasama ang midwife.

Ipaayos ang madulas na pasukan at ilayo muna ang mga tao sa panganib. Tiyaking may angkop na lalagyan ng sharps, hand-hygiene supplies at PPE na itinakda para sa gawain. Alamin ang ligtas na ruta at contact kapag may insidente. Kung kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon o lampas sa pagsasanay ang ipinapagawa, huminto at iakyat sa supervisor. Hindi pinapalitan ng gloves o mask ang pag-alis ng hazard kung kaya itong alisin.

## [field-preparation] Planuhin ang ligtas na pagbisita

Bago lumakad, suriin ang panahon, madulas na daan, aso at posibleng banta. Ipaalam ang ruta at inaasahang balik; gumamit ng buddy system kung itinakda ng lokal na protocol. Magdala ng inuming tubig at magplano ng lilim at pahinga sa init. Huwag tumuloy sa lugar na hindi ligtas; makipag-ugnayan para sa alternatibo. Iulat agad ang aksidente, kagat o pagkakasakit at sundin ang naaangkop na referral, sa halip na tapusin muna ang listahan ng bahay.

## [combined-hazards] Kapag pinagsama ang mga panganib

May dagsa ng kliyente, mainit ang silid at ubos ang ilang PPE. Sa grupo, tukuyin kung aling gawain ang kailangang ihinto, alin ang maaaring baguhin, at kanino hihingi ng desisyon. Isama ang kapasidad ng staff at daloy ng kliyente; huwag gawing tanging sagot ang dagdag na oras ng BHW. Maglatag ng isang ligtas na alternatibo na dapat aprubahan ng supervisor.

## [practice] Subukan, saka ulitin

Punan ang card: gawain at saklaw; supplies at proteksyon; ruta at panahon; contact at oras ng balik; dahilan para mag-pause. Sabihin sa kapareha: “Walang sabon at may banta sa ruta.” Ipakita kung ano ang hindi muna gagawin at kanino hihingi ng pasya. Kung mag-isa, sagutin ang parehong sitwasyon sa papel. Bago ang susunod na visit, kumpirmahin ang ruta at contact.

## [check] Piliin ang susunod na hakbang

Piliin ang sagot at ipaliwanag kung bakit bago tingnan ang feedback. Pagkatapos, ihambing sa sarili mong ginawa sa pagsasanay.
